_comment: Stimulant tuning (DESIGN.md §13.8). The stims themselves (buffs, delay, side effects) are items in data/items/meds/stims.json. effects: every effect kind the game knows, with its name and unit ("" no value, "%" share, "°" degrees, "#" plain number, "kg", "/min", "HP/s", "HP/s each part") and the colour of its HUD icon ring. overdose: injecting `threshold` or more stims within `window` seconds starts an Overdose for `duration` seconds (HP drain from every body part, tremor, blurred vision), each stim past the threshold `extra_per_stim` × worse. resistance: the Stim resistance skill shortens side effects by `per_level` a level up to `max`; injecting a stim earns `points_by_rarity` (Common .. Legendary) skill points. limb_restore_max_hp_loss: share of max HP a limb loses when a stim restores it.

painkiller.name: Painkiller
painkiller.about: No pain; broken or blacked legs can sprint and roll

regen.name: Regeneration
regen.about: Every damaged body part (not blacked ones) heals this much a second

hemostatic.name: Hemostatic
hemostatic.about: Bleeds do no damage (they don't stop)

limb_restore.name: Limb restoration
limb_restore.about: When it starts, every blacked limb and the stomach come back at this share of their max HP, losing some max HP

carry_weight.name: Carry weight
carry_weight.about: Weight you can carry before slowing down or being overweight

reload_speed.name: Reload speed
reload_speed.about: How fast reloads and jam clearing go

vision_range.name: Vision range
vision_range.about: How far your vision cone reaches

noise.name: Noise
noise.about: How far your footsteps and rolls are heard (negative: quieter)

blur.name: Blurred vision
blur.about: The view blurs and the vision cone narrows

fatigue.name: Fatigue
fatigue.about: The requested 'exhaustion' effect (named Fatigue so it isn't confused with the 0-energy Exhaustion status): stamina recovers this much slower and sprinting costs this much more

toxin.name: Toxicity
toxin.about: HP lost a second from the stomach (spreads once it's blacked)

hp_drain.name: HP drain
hp_drain.about: HP lost a second from every body part (Overdose)
